name: Cane, hollow
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 12
Price +1 gp; Weight —
Category Adventuring Gear
Description
A hollow cane has a false top that conceals a small compartment within the cane. The compartment is large enough to house a potion or vial. Spotting the secret compartment of a hollow cane requires a successful DC 18 Perception check.
